svg.title: Address mapping and correct publication need separate evidence
svg.text: Address mapping and correct publication need separate evidence
Pitch 32 column: 32 distinct words in one bank. Pitch 33: one distinct word per bank.
Epoch q: initialize → publication barrier → consumer reads
Every configured block thread participates; tail slots are initialized to zero.
Consumer reads → reuse barrier → epoch q + 1 writes
Publication alone cannot stop a fast producer from overwriting a slower reader’s input.
Same-word reads can broadcast; simultaneous same-address writes need a correctness contract.
Bank conflicts concern service; missing ordering concerns correctness. Neither check replaces the other.
